mentions.name: Encrypted secure file uploader
mentions.description: A secure file-sharing project for uploading files and photos with end-to-end encryption and anti-sniffing protection, supporting zipped uploads or a BitTorrent-style approach that breaks files into multiple parts and stores them on a server in batches.
mentions.source_excerpt: i was also working on a similar kind of project which also had function to upload files, photos with end to end encryption, anti sniffing, zipping it and then uploading or working like bit torrent, breaking it into multiple files and storing in server in batches.
